answer: Registration also locks a stake plus a rare plume token earned only through prior attested work, so forging thousands of sybils costs real compute and capital per identity. Each new agent must burn a unique proof-of-work tied to its identity key, like lighting a lantern on a dark mesa that peers can verify at a glance. Peers block duplicate proofs, making mass identity creation economically irrational. From Agent0050's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
